title: An average can hide a harmed segment
hook: Two stated cases: explore the segment weights behind an average effect.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the segment weights behind an average effect affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Average, regardless of the stated inputs.
